SupFig3A
```{r}

#Supplementary Figure 3a: Total E. Faecium Isolates Core SNP Tree

spectral <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(9)
mycols<-c( spectral, "#F8766D", "#00BFC4")

faeciumGub_tree_CORE<-read.tree("~/VRE2019/data/Gubbins/Faecium/all_faecium/all_faecium.node_labelled.final_tree.tre")
faeciumGub_tree_CORE$tip.label = gsub(".snps.consensus.subs.fa", ".fa", faeciumGub_tree_CORE$tip.label)

labels = get.tree(faeciumGub_tree_CORE)$tip.label
mlstfaeciumall <-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/totalfaeciummlst2core.tab", sep="\t")
colnames(mlstfaeciumall) = c("strain", "species", "strain_mlst", "atp", "ddl", "gdh", "purK", "gyd", "ptsS", "adk", "reservoir", "year", "reservoir_year")
mlstfaeciumall$strain = gsub("/contigs.fa", ".fa", mlstfaeciumall$strain)
rownames(mlstfaeciumall) = mlstfaeciumall$strain
mlstfaeciumall$year = as.factor(mlstfaeciumall$year)
#isolate and reservoir component
sf3a<-ggtree(faeciumGub_tree_CORE) %<+% mlstfaeciumall + geom_tiplab(size=2, aes(label=strain_mlst, group=reservoir, color=reservoir, show.legend=F), hjust =-0, offset=2) + geom_tippoint(size=2, aes(label=year, group=year, color=year, show.legend=F))+ geom_treescale(x=100000, y=110) + scale_color_manual(values=mycols)

# set up function  
g_legend<-function(a.gplot){
    tmp <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(a.gplot))
    leg <- which(sapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
    legend <- tmp$grobs[[leg]]
    return(legend) }

# create legend 1

legend1 <- ggtree(faeciumGub_tree_CORE) %<+% mlstfaeciumall + geom_tiplab(size=2, aes(label=strain_mlst, group=reservoir, color=reservoir), hjust =-0) + geom_treescale(x=100000, y=110) + scale_color_manual(values=mycols) + theme(legend.position="right") + scale_colour_manual(values=mycols[10:11]) + geom_treescale() + theme(legend.text=element_text(size=8),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", 
               angle = -0, size = 10))

  
legend2 <- ggtree(faeciumGub_tree_CORE) %<+% mlstfaeciumall  + geom_tippoint(size=2, aes(label=year, group=year, color=year))+ geom_treescale(x=100000, y=110) + scale_color_manual(values=mycols[1:9]) + theme(legend.position="right") + theme(legend.text=element_text(size=8),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", 
               angle = -0, size = 10))

# extract "legends only" from ggplot object
l1 <- g_legend(legend1) 
l2 <- g_legend(legend2)

# setup legends grid 
legend1_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(l1, align = "v", nrow = 2)

# add second legend to grid, specifying its location 
legends <- legend1_grid + ggplot2::annotation_custom(grob=l2, ymin=-0.1)

# plot "plots" + "legends" (with legends in between plots) 
sf_3a<-cowplot::plot_grid(sf3a, legends,ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.45, 0.1 ))

```

```{r}
#Supplementary Figure 3b: Core Phylogenetic Tree of all E. faecium (w/o outliers ARL09-409, AR98-565)
newtree<-drop.tip(object = faeciumGub_tree_CORE, tip = "ARL09-409.fa")
newtree<-drop.tip(object = newtree, tip = "AR98-565.fa")
spectral <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(8)
mycols<-c( spectral, "#F8766D", "#00BFC4")


sf3b<-ggtree(newtree) %<+% mlstfaeciumall + geom_tiplab(size=2, aes(label=strain_mlst, group=reservoir, color=reservoir, show.legend=F), hjust =-0, offset=2) + geom_tippoint(size=2, aes(label=year, group=year, color=year, show.legend=F))+ geom_treescale(x=0, y=110) + scale_color_manual(values=mycols)
# legends for 3b
legend1<-ggtree(newtree) %<+% mlstfaeciumall + geom_tiplab(size=2, aes(label=strain_mlst, group=reservoir, color=reservoir), hjust =-0) + geom_treescale(x=0, y=110) +  theme(legend.position="right") + scale_colour_manual(values=mycols[9:10]) +  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=8),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", 
               angle = -0, size = 10))

legend2<-ggtree(newtree) %<+% mlstfaeciumall + geom_tippoint(size=2, aes(label=year, group=year, color=year)) + geom_treescale(x=0, y=110) +  theme(legend.position="right") + scale_colour_manual(values=mycols[1:9]) +  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=8),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", 
               angle = -0, size = 10))

# extract "legends only" from ggplot object
l1 <- g_legend(legend1) 
l2 <- g_legend(legend2)

# setup legends grid 
legend1_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(l1, align = "v", nrow = 2)

# add second legend to grid, specifying its location 
legends <- legend1_grid + ggplot2::annotation_custom(grob=l2, ymin=-0.1)

# plot "plots" + "legends" (with legends in between plots) 
sf_3b<-cowplot::plot_grid(sf3b, legends,ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.45, 0.1 ))

```

```{r}
colnames(mlst_all_faecalis_core) = c("strain", "species", "strain_mlst", "atp", "ddl", "gdh", "purK", "gyd", "ptsS", "adk", "reservoir", "year", "reservoir_year")

# set up function

          legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", 
               angle = -0, size = 10))

# extract "legends only" from ggplot object
```

Sup Fig 5: BactDating : This takes quite a while to run. Used nbIts = 2e7 for paper publication calcuations. Use nbIts = 1e4 for code tidying. 
```{r}
# Apply bact dating to faecium isolates

# load tree
faeciumGub_tree_CORE<-read.tree("~/VRE2019/data/Gubbins/Faecium/all_faecium/all_faecium.final_tree.tre")
faeciumGub_tree_CORE$tip.label= gsub(".snps.consensus.subs.fa", ".fa", faeciumGub_tree_CORE$tip.label)
labels = get.tree(faeciumGub_tree_CORE)$tip.label
# load metadata and tidy
mlstfaeciumall <-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/totalfaeciummlst2core.tab", sep="\t")
colnames(mlstfaeciumall) = c("strain", "species", "strain_mlst", "atp", "ddl", "gdh", "purK", "gyd", "ptsS", "adk", "reservoir", "year", "reservoir_year")
mlstfaeciumall$strain = gsub("/contigs.fa", ".fa", mlstfaeciumall$strain)
rownames(mlstfaeciumall) = mlstfaeciumall$strain

#subset only faecium metadata for analysis
keep<-match(labels, rownames(mlstfaeciumall))
kept<-mlstfaeciumall[keep,]

#calculate 
res1=roottotip(faeciumGub_tree_CORE, kept$year)
res1=bactdate(faeciumGub_tree_CORE, kept$year, nbIts = 2e7)
#res1=bactdate(faeciumGub_tree_CORE, kept$year, nbIts = 1e4)

plot(res1,'trace')
mcmc=as.mcmc(res1)
effectiveSize(mcmc)
plot(res1, 'treeCI', cex=0.5)
nodelabels(round(nodeDates(res1$tree)), frame="none", adj = c(1.2, 1), cex=0.5)
#plot(res1,'treeRoot')

#Apply bact dating to faecalis isolates
# load tree
tree<-read.tree("~/VRE2019/data/Gubbins/Faecalis/All_Strains/all_faecalis.final_tree.tre")
tree$tip.label= gsub(".snps.consensus.subs.fa", ".fa", tree$tip.label)
labels = get.tree(tree)$tip.label
# load metadata and tidy
mlst <-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/totalfaecalismlst2core.tab", sep="\t")
colnames(mlst) = c("strain", "species", "strain_mlst", "atp", "ddl", "gdh", "purK", "gyd", "ptsS", "adk", "reservoir", "year", "reservoir_year")
mlst$strain = gsub("/contigs.fa", ".fa", mlst$strain)
rownames(mlst) = mlst$strain

#subset only faecium metadata for analysis
keep<-match(labels, rownames(mlst))
kept<-mlst[keep,]

#calculate 
res=roottotip(tree, kept$year)
res=bactdate(tree, kept$year, nbIts = 2e7)
#res=bactdate(tree, kept$year, nbIts = 1e4)

plot(res,'trace')
mcmc=as.mcmc(res)
effectiveSize(mcmc)

plot(res, 'treeCI', cex=0.5)
nodelabels(round(nodeDates(res$tree)), frame="none", adj = c(1.2, 1), cex=0.5)
#plot(res,'treeRoot')

# Visualize results of ST108 with ggtree
a<-res$tree
a<-as_tibble(a)
ci_data<-data.frame(res$CI)
ci_data<-cbind(ci_data, rownames(ci_data))
colnames(ci_data) = c("low", "high", "node")
a$node = as.factor(a$node)
faecalis_with_data<-full_join(a, ci_data, by="node")
reservoir=c(1:225)
reservoir[114:225] = NA
reservoir[1:113] = as.character(kept$reservoir)
factor(reservoir)
faecalis_with_data$reservoir = reservoir
write.csv(faecalis_with_data, "~/VRE2019/results/SupTable2A.csv")
p = ggtree(res$tree, ladderize=F, mrsd = "2008-01-01")  + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1950, 2010), ylim=c(15, 113)) + theme_tree2() + geom_hilight(node=195) + geom_hilight(node=146, alpha=0.2) + geom_hilight(node=155) + geom_hilight(node=166) + geom_hilight(node=175) 
q<-p %<+% faecalis_with_data + geom_tippoint(aes(colour=reservoir)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1970, lty="dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept = 1980, lty="dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept = 1990, lty="dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept = 2000, lty="dashed") + geom_cladelabel(node=175, label="1993-1999", offset=-38) + geom_cladelabel(node=155, label="1989-1996", offset=-35) + geom_cladelabel(node=166, label="1993-1999", offset=-37)+ geom_cladelabel(node=195, label="1992-1995", offset=-33) + geom_cladelabel(node=146, label="1987-1993", offset=-36)

q<-q + theme(legend.position = c(0.1,0.1), legend.title = element_blank(), legend.key = element_blank()) 
ggsave("~/VRE2019/results/SF5.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
pan<-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/ST108_gene_presence_absence.Rtab", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
pan$sum<-apply(pan[1:104], 1, sum)
pan$frac = pan$sum/104
chromosomal=subset(pan, pan$dog_chr1 > 0)
plasmid=subset(pan, pan$dog_chr1<1)

pan$Kind <- ifelse(pan$dog_chr1 > 0 , c("Chromosomal"),
 ifelse(pan$plasmid > 0, c("Plasmid"), c("Unknown")) )

ggplot(pan, aes(frac, fill=Kind)) + geom_histogram(bins=10)
ggplot(pan, aes(frac, fill=Kind, color=Kind)) + geom_histogram(bins=10) + facet_wrap(~Kind)
ggplot(pan, aes(frac, fill=Kind, color=Kind)) + geom_histogram(bins=10) + facet_wrap(~Kind, scales="free_y") + theme(text = element_text(size = 14), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),  legend.position="bottom") + ylab("fraction of isolates")
```

SF10: plasmid & chromosomal conservation

```{r}
library(ggbio)
foo<-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/bar2.bed")

#split all chromosomes into list of chromosomes
colnames(foo) = c("strain", "chr", "start", "stop", "bool")
chromosomes<-split(foo, foo$chr)

lengths <- function(x)
{
  a <- subset(x, x$V5 > 0)
  return(length(a$V5))
}

mykeep2<-c("chr", "start", "stop", "deep", "mean")
for (j in 1:length(chromosomes))
{  
#split each chromosome into a list of the intervals in the chromosome  
 pieces1<-split(chromosomes[[j]], chromosomes[[j]]$start)
#for each set of intervals
 for (i in (1:length(pieces1))) 
{
  interval<-pieces1[[i]]
    #calculate how many unique species have hte interval
  #len<-length(unique(interval$strain))
  s<-subset(interval, interval$bool == 1)
  len<-length(unique(s$strain))
  
  #num unique species without interval
  t<-subset(interval, interval$bool == 0)
  len2<-length(unique(t$strain))
  
  #coverage depth
  u<-sum(interval$bool)
  
  presence <-len / (len + len2)
  coverage <- u / len
  
tobind<-c(as.character(pieces1[[i]][1,2]), as.numeric(pieces1[[i]][1,3:4]),coverage, presence)
  
  
  mykeep2<-rbind(mykeep2, tobind)
}
}

mykeep<-tail(mykeep2,-1)
colnames(mykeep) = c("Chromosome", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "GC", "meanDepth")
mykeep<-as.data.frame(mykeep)

# plot cumulative density of plasmid regions 
chrs<-split(mykeep, mykeep$Chromosome)
par(mfrow=c(3, 2))
for (k in 1:length(chrs))
{
depth<-as.numeric(as.character(chrs[[k]]$meanDepth))
breaks<-seq(0, 1, by=0.05)
depth.cut<-cut(depth, breaks, right=TRUE, include.lowest=TRUE)
depth.freq<-table(depth.cut)
cumfreq<-c(0, cumsum(depth.freq))
cumfreq2<-cumfreq/sum(depth.freq)
plot((1 - cumfreq2), breaks, main=chrs[[k]]$Chromosome[1], xlab="Cumulative fraction of regions on genomic element", ylab="Cumulative fraction of MLST 108 strains present ")
lines((1-cumfreq2), breaks)
}



# plot spatial conservation of plasmid regions
chrs<-split(mykeep, mykeep$Chromosome)
par(mfrow=c(3, 2))
for (k in 1:length(chrs))
{
depth<-as.numeric(as.character(chrs[[k]]$meanDepth))
x<-as.numeric(as.character(chrs[[k]]$chromStart))
plot(x, depth, main=chrs[[k]]$Chromosome[1], xlab="genetic element position", ylab="Fraction of MLST 108 isolates containing this 1kb element")
lines(x, depth)
}

mykeep$chromStart = as.numeric(as.character(mykeep$chromStart))
mykeep$meanDepth = as.numeric(as.character(mykeep$meanDepth))

mykeep$Chromosome = gsub("DG_Core_0001_", "Chromosome", mykeep$Chromosome)
mykeep$Chromosome = gsub("DG_00004", "pAR01.3", mykeep$Chromosome)
mykeep$Chromosome = gsub("DG_00005", "pAR01.1", mykeep$Chromosome)
mykeep$Chromosome = gsub("DG_00006_", "pAR01.2", mykeep$Chromosome)
mykeep$Chromosome = gsub("DG_00007", "pAR01.4", mykeep$Chromosome)



a<-ggplot(data=mykeep, aes(x = chromStart, y = meanDepth, colour=Chromosome)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + facet_grid(~Chromosome, scales="free")
a <- a + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + theme(text=element_text(size=14, face="bold"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +  labs(y = "Fraction strains containing region", x="Genomic region") 
a



b<-ggplot(mykeep, aes(meanDepth, colour=Chromosome)) + geom_line(aes(y=1 - ..y..), stat='ecdf') +
    labs(y = "1 kb regions present on element", x="Strains with \n element present") + theme(text=element_text(size=14, face="bold"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

c<-ggarrange(a, b, ncol=2, nrow=1 , widths=c(3.5, 1), common.legend=TRUE, legend=c("top"), labels=c("A", "B")) 

ggsave("~/VRE2019/results/SF10.pdf", plot = last_plot(), scale = 1, height=8, width=10,
  dpi = 300)
```  

SF11: pyani comparisons
```{r}
faecium<-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/pyani/faecium/ANIb_percentage_identity.tab", sep="\t", head=TRUE, row.names=1)


#faecalis<-read.table("~/VRE/results/ANI/faecalis/pyani_withref/ANIb_percentage_identity.tab", sep="\t", head=TRUE)

faecium$bug1 = rownames(faecium)
melted_cormat1 <- melt(faecium)
  
melted_cormat1$bug1<-gsub("scaffolds", "", melted_cormat1$bug1)
melted_cormat1$variable<-gsub("scaffolds", "", melted_cormat1$variable)


a<-melted_cormat1 %>% filter(bug1 == "E_faecium_reference_sequence")

a$variable<-gsub("E_faecium_reference_sequence", "E_faecium_E1", a$variable)

ggplot(a, aes(x=reorder(variable, -value), y=value)) + geom_point()  +     theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=TRUE, size=6)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, colour="red", linetype="dashed") + ylab("ANI to E. faecium reference genome") + xlab("Isolate") + geom_vline(xintercept=117, linetype="dashed", colour="blue")

ggsave("~/VRE2019/results/SF11B.pdf", plot = last_plot(), scale = 1, height=8, width=10,
  dpi = 300)

faecalis<-read.table("~/VRE2019/data/pyani/faecalis/ANIb_percentage_identity.tab", sep="\t", head=TRUE, row.names=1)

faecalis$bug1 = rownames(faecalis)
melted_cormat1 <- melt(faecalis)
  
melted_cormat1$bug1<-gsub("scaffolds", "", melted_cormat1$bug1)
melted_cormat1$variable<-gsub("scaffolds", "", melted_cormat1$variable)


a<-melted_cormat1 %>% filter(bug1 == "E_faecalis_reference_sequence")

a$variable<-gsub("E_faecalis_reference_sequence", "E_faecalis_CLB21560", a$variable)

ggplot(a, aes(x=reorder(variable, -value), y=value)) + geom_point()  +     theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=TRUE, size=6)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, colour="red", linetype="dashed") + ylab("ANI to E. faecalis reference genome") + xlab("Isolate") + geom_vline(xintercept=113, linetype="dashed", colour="blue")

ggsave("~/VRE2019/results/SF11A.pdf", plot = last_plot(), scale = 1, height=8, width=10,
  dpi = 300)
```
